summary: iteration_845: E2E validation of the Travel Visa Certificate v2 rebuild (redesigned PDF, PDF middleware exemption, new public /verify endpoint, v7 award email + attachment, new frontend Certificates tab). Backend pytest 9/9 PASS via http://localhost:8001. Frontend E2E via http://localhost:3000 covers: admin login → /features/travel-visa (with onboarding skip) → click new 3rd tab 'Certificates' → tv-certificates-root renders with 'My Certificates' title and 3 verifiable cards (score ring, cert_id, date, 'Verifiable' badge, 3 buttons: Download PDF / Email me a copy / Copy verify link). Email button POST returns 200 + backend logs the send. Copy-verify-link button copies URL and shows feedback (graceful URL fallback in headless — see below). FR i18n switch translates tab label ('Certificats'), title ('Mes certificats'), subtitle, all 3 buttons ('Télécharger PDF' / 'Envoyez-moi une copie par email' / 'Copier le lien de vérification') and 'Vérifiable' badge — zero raw 'travelVisa.certificates.' key leaks in EN or FR. 390px mobile has no horizontal page overflow; buttons wrap. Explore + Progress tabs still render fine. No console crashes attributable to the new component.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with {valid:false, recipient:null, ...} for unknown IDs; spec said 404. HTML variant correctly returns 404. Recommend aligning JSON to 404 (or documenting the design choice).

integration_issues.issue: In headless browsers where navigator.clipboard.writeText throws (no user gesture / no permission), the code falls back to setFeedback({id, msg: url}) — so the raw URL string is displayed instead of the localized 'Verification link copied' / 'Lien de vérification copié'. Works in a normal user-driven browser. Consider still showing the localized 'copied' message even in the fallback branch (or a 'Link ready' message with the URL below).
Feedback text auto-clears at 4000ms which is fine for humans but flaky in automated pipelines; not a defect.

curl_evidence.POST /api/travel-visa/certificate/genera: 200 -> cert_id issued (TV-3B9E5136 etc.) + email_status field present
curl_evidence.GET /api/travel-visa/certificate/downloa: 200 application/pdf, header x-pdf-theme-policy: exempt-travel-visa-certificate, body starts with %PDF
curl_evidence.GET /api/travel-visa/certificate/verify/: 200 {valid:false} <-- minor spec deviation, HTML variant is 404 correctly
curl_evidence.GET /api/travel-visa/certificate/list/us: 200 3 certificates returned; new cert_id from generate is in the list

frontend_evidence.login_flow: admin@realaicoach.app login via press_sequentially on placeholder inputs (data-testid fill() sets value but does not trigger RN onChangeText — this is a known issue with react-native-web + fill()). SIGN IN triggered POST /api/auth/login 200 and redirected to /.
frontend_evidence.travel_visa_tab_strip_certificates: data-testid='tv-v2-tab-certificates' present at 3rd position (after Explore + Progress). Click activates the panel.
frontend_evidence.certificates_tab_light_dark_default: tv-certificates-root + tv-certificates-title='My Certificates' + 3 tv-certificate-card-* rendered. Each card: 88% score ring (or 96%), course_title, cert_id text, ISO date, 'Verifiable' badge with shield icon, tv-certificate-download-<id> + tv-certificate-email-<id> + tv-certificate-verify-<id> buttons. Body text contains 'Schengen Visa Essentials' + 'US F1 Student Visa Interview Mastery'. No i18n key leaks in EN.
frontend_evidence.email_button_integration: Clicking tv-certificate-email-TV-3B9E5136 fires POST /api/travel-visa/certificate/email/TV-3B9E5136 -> 200. Backend log shows Resend email sent (tested twice in this iteration).
frontend_evidence.copy_verify_button: Clicking tv-certificate-verify-<id> shows tv-certificate-feedback with the URL 'http://localhost:3000/api/travel-visa/certificate/verify/TV-3B9E5136' — this is the CLIPBOARD-FAILED graceful fallback path (headless has no navigator.clipboard permission). In a real user browser this shows the localized 'Verification link copied' message.
frontend_evidence.fr_i18n: After clicking language-switcher-btn on dashboard and selecting Français option: TV tab label='Certificats', title='Mes certificats', subtitle translated, buttons='Télécharger PDF' / 'Envoyez-moi une copie par email' / 'Copier le lien de vérification', badge='Vérifiable', 'Essentiels du visa Schengen' course_title also localized. Zero raw 'travelVisa.certificates.' keys leaked. FR translations verified present at /app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/fr.ts lines 10873-10886.
frontend_evidence.mobile_390_responsive: At 390x844: certificates tab renders without horizontal page overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth); 3 cards stack; card box 362x156px inside 390 viewport. Buttons wrap to a new row (flexWrap:'wrap' honoured).
frontend_evidence.regression: Explore tab (tv-v2-tab-explore -> tv-v2-explore-panel) still renders. Progress tab renders 5+ tv-v2-progress* elements. No red console errors caused by TravelVisaCertificates (only pre-existing 401 /api/auth/me polling + one ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR asset — unchanged from prior iterations).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align JSON variant of GET /api/travel-visa/certificate/verify/{id}?format=json to return 404 for unknown IDs (currently 200 with valid:false). HTML variant is already 404-correct. If the JSON 200/{valid:false} is intentional (e.g. QR scanners want structured 'not valid' JSON), document it in the API contract.

OPTIONAL: In TravelVisaCertificates.onCopyVerify(), even when navigator.clipboard.writeText throws, still show the localized 'Verification link copied' feedback text (or a distinct 'Link ready — long-press to copy' message). Currently the raw URL becomes the feedback which is functional but not on-brand.
critical_code_review_comments: TravelVisaCertificates.tsx (191 lines) is compact, uses tx(key, fallback) pattern with English fallbacks baked in (safe for i18n adoption scanner) and correctly maps score>=70 to success ring color, <70 to warning. All 3 CTA buttons have data-testid + testID for automation. Nice: card key by cert_id; feedback element keyed by cert_id so it stays with the correct card.

onCopyVerify uses api base URL via api.defaults.baseURL — so the copied verify link is 'http://localhost:3000/api/travel-visa/certificate/verify/<id>'. In production this must resolve to the real domain via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — validated indirectly by verifying the axios base URL was applied and the URL was a full absolute URL (not a relative path).
Verify HTML endpoint correctly returns 404 for unknown IDs — great. But JSON variant returns 200 with {valid:false}. Recommend one policy across both variants.
onEmail path: on success sets feedback to 'Certificate emailed to your inbox' (or 'Email queued — delivery pending' if status != 'sent'). Auto-clears at 4000ms — acceptable UX.

Backend middleware exemption verified: HTTP response header 'x-pdf-theme-policy: exempt-travel-visa-certificate' is present on the download endpoint, so the v15 global overlay won't stamp over the certificate PDF. Content-Type is application/pdf and body begins with %PDF-1.7 magic bytes.
TravelVisaMain.tsx wiring: activeTab === 'certificates' renders <TravelVisaCertificates userId={authUserId} /> inside a padded View. isMobile=14 padding / desktop=20 — clean.
Ownership check on email endpoint: wrong user_id returns 403 — good. Recommend adding the same check on download endpoint if not already there (not tested here).

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest passed: generate, download+exempt-header, verify-HTML-valid, verify-JSON-valid, verify-invalid-404-HTML, verify-invalid-JSON-tolerated, email-owner-ok, email-wrong-user-403, list-user-certs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the core certificate flow (tab renders, cards render, all 3 CTAs present, email→200, FR i18n fully translated, 390px mobile clean, Explore+Progress regression clean). Copy-verify feedback shows the URL in headless mode (graceful fallback) rather than the localized 'copied' string — flagged as minor UX polish.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend login on this build MUST use press_sequentially() on the placeholder-based inputs (get_by_placeholder('you@example.com') / get_by_placeholder('Enter password')). page.fill([data-testid=login-email-input], ...) sets the DOM value but does NOT trigger react-native-web TextInput onChangeText, so the button click is a no-op with empty state. Then click get_by_role('button', name='SIGN IN'). Wait for POST /api/auth/login 200 via page.expect_response. The Travel Visa page shows an onboarding overlay by default (tv-v2-onboarding-root) — dismiss it via [data-testid='tv-v2-onboarding-skip'] before clicking any tv-v2-tab-* buttons, otherwise clicks hit the overlay. Language switcher testid on dashboard: 'language-switcher-btn' — opens a full-screen language picker; Français option is discoverable by text=/^Français$/. Backend uses http://localhost:8001 directly (external URL is Cloudflare-challenged). CSRF middleware requires 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' header on POST/state-changing routes.
rca of the issue: N/A — the Travel Visa Certificate v2 rebuild is verified end-to-end. Only two minor advisory items surface: (a) verify?format=json returns 200 with valid:false for unknown IDs (HTML correctly 404s), and (b) copy-verify feedback shows the raw URL when clipboard write fails (graceful fallback but not localized). Neither blocks release.
